mentions.name: ruscv
mentions.description: A RISC-V assembler and simulator implemented in Rust, built as a way to learn the RISC-V ISA and gain confidence in the Rust language; currently working on pseudoinstruction support.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm implementing a RISC-V assembler and simulator in Rust. It's been a great excuse to learn the ISA and gain some confidence in the language. Now I'm working on pseudoinstructions and it makes me feel like i'm back in college!
